answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now an integral enabler of enterprise applications and offerings, including code and data co-pilots , retrieval augmented generation (RAG) , summarization , and agentic workflows .
answer_1.outputs: The paper addresses NLG tasks such as summarization, code generation, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows, which involve generating natural language responses based on input prompts.
